[[File:Effigy of Solus Prime Icon.jpg|right]] 
The Effigy of Solus Prime is a Relic that can be earned uopn completing Act 3.

==Description==

''A relic depicting the form of Solus Prime, builder for the first Thirteen Primes. This is awarded to those who master Story Mode Act 3.''

==Relic Boosts==

*Relic Health Boost: All Bots gain 4% Health in all game modes.
